items.title: 6.8 Validation aur model ki behtari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8 before its first sub-heading (PDF 86-87); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Validation se jaancha jata hai ke model naye data par kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh training aur testing ke baad kiya jata hai taake model ki reliability (qabil-e-bharosa hona) pakki ho. Yeh model ko data ratt lene (memorize karne) se bachati hai aur munsifana jaanch mein madad deti hai. Validation ke results se feedback milta hai jis se model behtar kiya jata hai: kamzor hisse pehchan kar theek kiye jate hain. Asal istemal se pehle validation zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Validation dekhti hai ke model naye data par kaise chalta hai, aur overfitting (training data ratt lena) se bachati hai. Model ko tuning aur chhoti tabdeeliyon se behtar kiya jata hai. Achhi validation se bharosa barhta hai, aur mazboot models asal halaat mein achha kaam karte hain.
